mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 units, indicating increased consumer spending, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1300 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs decrease.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the strengthening labor market.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.10) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth above 4% YoY indicates increased consumer spending power, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not positively correlated with RSAFS growth (p > 0.10) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points within a quarter signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate inflation.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to decreased consumer spending power.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, indicating no significant relationship.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth below 2% YoY, combined with a decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY, signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and HOUST decrease > 10% YoY
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.10) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.
